LESSON: SARUFI 6.4.1 NGELI YA U- YA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.4: Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. explain what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA means in simple pupil language
2. give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA from Kenya
3. practise Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in clear steps
4. apply Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in one real-life situation this week

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SARUFI 6.4.1 NGELI YA U- YA
Subject: KISWAHILI · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA helps you succeed in KISWAHILI. You will understand it, practise it, and use it nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

KEY FACTS: SARUFI 6.4.1 NGELI YA U- YA
Study Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA means in simple pupil language

What this means
In this part you learn to explain what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA means in simple pupil language. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA means in simple pupil language.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA means in simple pupil language. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA from Kenya

In this part you learn to give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA from Kenya. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA from Kenya.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuzungumza: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA from Kenya. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Practise Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in clear steps

What this means
In this part you learn to practise Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in clear steps. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kuandika: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can practise Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in clear steps. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Apply Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in one real-life situation this week

What this means
In this part you learn to apply Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in one real-life situation this week. You will use ideas from nyumbani, shuleni, na sokoni.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: apply Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in one real-life situation this week.
2. Soma, sema, kisha andika using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Mfano wa kusoma: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can apply Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in one real-life situation this week. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: explain what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA means in simple pupil language)

Example 2: Zungumza na rafiki kwa dakika 1 kuhusu Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA. (skill: give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA from Kenya)

Example 3: Andika sentensi 3 sahihi kuhusu Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA. (skill: practise Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in clear steps)

Example 4: Soma sentensi fupi kuhusu “Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA”, kisha eleza kwa maneno yako. (skill: apply Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in one real-life situation this week)

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA means in simple pupil language.
3. Practise this skill: give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA from Kenya.
4. Practise this skill: practise Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA in clear steps.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Know what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain what Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA means in simple pupil language.
5. Be able to: give 3 correct examples of Sarufi 6.4.1 Ngeli ya U- YA from Kenya.

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
